name: Jokim
title: Descendant of Shelah
summary: Jokim is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles chapter 4, as a descendant of Judah through Shelah. He is listed in a genealogy of Judah's descendants, and there is very little information about him beyond his place in the family register. He belonged to a group that had dominion over Moab and returned to Bethlehem.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jokim is listed as a descendant of Shelah, son of Judah, in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles. His lineage is connected to dominion over Moab.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Shelah's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Jokim belonged to the lineage of Shelah, who was one of Judah's sons. This lineage held historical significance within the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Moab
keyEvents.description: Jokim's family had dominion in Moab according to ancient records. This suggests that his family had political and territorial influence outside the core area of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Affiliation with Linen Workers
keyEvents.description: Jokim's family is connected to men from Keziba and groups who worked with linen and pottery. This shows their role in craftsmanship and production in ancient Israel.
